subject: Proposal: No-PO onboarding safeguards for small vendors (Vertima pilot)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Kramer <ellis@vertima.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: No-PO onboarding safeguards for small vendors (Vertima pilot)

Hi team / Ellis —

Thanks for the quick conversation yesterday. As discussed, Vertima is asking to onboard without the formal PO requirement for the first 3 months so they can trial integration and early billing cadence. Procurement/Finance policy defaults to PO-first, but I’d like to propose a controlled exception pilot for small monthly spend vendors to reduce friction for early-stage integrations.

Proposal (summary):
- Scope: Vendors with committed monthly spend <= $5,000 and invoices < $25k total in any 30-day period.
- Controls required for exception:
  - Signed MPA with payment terms (attached draft)
  - Billing cadence confirmed (net 30) + invoice email to AP mailbox
  - Vendor must use vendor portal onboarding form (attached: vertima_onboarding_form.pdf)
  - Finance-backed PO-waiver approval (one-time) with audit ticket created
  - SOC2 Type II (or equivalent) evidence on file OR weekly monitoring for first 60 days
- Approval matrix:
  - Procurement approves operational waiver; Finance approves payment risk (VP Finance sign-off); Legal approves contract redline.
- Pilot duration: 90 days, after which we evaluate for broader rule changes.

Next steps I’m proposing: Monica to open PR-3478 in procurement and route to Alex Chen (Finance) for waiver sign-off. Laura, if you can review the attached MPA redlines and confirm the minimum clause language I flagged, we can push DocuSign for signature. Ellis — can you confirm billing cadence and the contact for invoices?

Attachments: vertima_onboarding_form.pdf, MPA draft (attached as a docx in next reply).

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships (acting)

Thanks — I reviewed the MPA and made 3 minimal redlines focused on payment and audit rights. I’ve attached signed-mpa-draft.docx with comments. Key items to confirm before waiver:
- SOC2 Type II or equivalent evidence: if not available, include a clause for increased monitoring and a right to audit during pilot window.
- Liability / indemnity: maintain baseline commercial limits; don’t weaken.
- Automatic rollback: if invoices exceed thresholds or we see anomalous billing, the waiver is rescinded and PO requirement enforced.

If Ellis can sign the DocuSign link (I can send once procurement confirms waiver routing), we’ll be ready to onboard.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
